    .site-shell {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        height: 100vh;

    .site-main {
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .site-shell,
    .site-main,
    .site-main > .container-fluid,
    .admin-page-shell {
        min-height: 0;
    }

    .site-main,

        display: flex;
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        flex-direction: column;
    }

    .admin-page-shell {
        gap: 1.5rem;
        padding: 0.5rem 0 1.5rem;
    }

    .admin-page-header {
        flex: 0 0 auto;
    }

    .admin-page-header h2 {
        margin: 0;
    }

    .admin-page-content {
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .admin-page-content > .component {
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        min-height: 0;
    }
</style>
